description: Crawl https://books.toscrape.com/ using Screaming Frog SEO Spider and generate a standard XML Sitemap. STEPS: 1) Crawl the website. 2) Once finished, go to Sitemaps > XML Sitemap. 3) Configure the sitemap to include ONLY HTML pages (ensure PDFs and images are uncheck/excluded). 4) Save the sitemap to ~/Documents/SEO/sitemaps/sitemap.xml. 5) Create a brief text summary at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/sitemap_summary.txt that includes the domain name, the total URL count, and today's date.
